what: item 2: STRATA_ROUTE_PRIOR=lambda campaign - screen, quality battery, clean confirmation, ADOPTED 0.5
mechanism: cache-conditioned routing (route_prior.cu, arXiv 2412.00099 without training): when the router picks the top-10, a resident expert gets a lambda logit bonus; the weights stay the unbiased softmax renormalised over the picks. Output-changing. Requires NE==512, K==10 (this model: yes) and the residency table.

screen.verdict_bug: the screen's verdict script used an inverted ms/round sign (it treated faster rounds as regressions); the raw numbers are kept and were re-read with the correct sign. Fixed in the script.

confirmation.design: clean alternation, same binary (build-0145, 0.1.45-8eb3e85d), base = env unset, arm = STRATA_ROUTE_PRIOR=0.5

mechanism_measured.reading: the prior cuts the CPU/PCIe expert traffic that the campaign measured as the decode wall. At 32K the round is also faster (-9.3%); at 1K the round is neutral (+1.1% median) and the gain is mostly the drafter's acceptance on the new trajectory (0.79 -> 0.94 ratio in the matching cells); at 128K tok/s is neutral while the round is -15.4%.

adoption.change: env STRATA_ROUTE_PRIOR=0.5 added; note records OUTPUT-CHANGING and the rollback
adoption.restart: systemctl --user restart strata-8081; health ok after ~24 s; engine up
adoption.rollback: restore the .bak and restart; unset/=0 also restores the base outputs

honest_caveats: output-changing: quality gated by the rehearsed battery (7/8=7/8, no regressions), not by KL (infeasible on native packs)
at 1K the gain is mostly acceptance on the new trajectory, not round time; at 32K both improve; at 128K only the round improves
the batch/parallel workloads were not tested (single-user production)
